title: Can I DEFEAT Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs online humans (2+1); goal win five games. Drawbacks seen include Pawn Battle (lose if you have fewer pawns than the opponent), Lame Duck, True Gentleman, a rook-must-defend-king type, Unlucky (can't move to half of squares, re-randomized every move) and Warlord (from move 12 on your king must not be on your first two ranks or you lose).
rules: Standard setup; each side a secret random drawback; revealed after game.

Drawbacks: Pawn Battle; Lame Duck (can't move king); True Gentleman (can't capture a queen); Unlucky (can't move to half of the squares, re-randomized every move); Warlord (at the start of move 12 and onwards, your king must not be on the first two ranks, or you lose); a drawback requiring a rook to defend the king (exact text not captured).
win_condition: Capture the enemy king / opponent triggers drawback / time. Goal 5 wins.

board.theme_notes: Drawback site brown/cream board on purple UI, 2+1 clocks, chessreps sponsor.

events: Unlucky: forbidden squares re-randomize every move (half of squares shaded)
